release_notes:
v1.0.12+12 - Live Sessions Matrix & Studio Utilization Integrity Overhaul
- Zero Phantom Live Sessions: Completely wiped test/stale entries from Central Mind live_sessions table.
- Student Onboarding & Teacher Assignment Isolation: Eradicated artificial side-effect inserts into live_sessions during walk-in onboarding and faculty assignment.
- Strict Studio Room In-Session Metric: Studio utilization KPI strictly counts currently active live sessions within their scheduled duration window (0/5 when idle).
- Automatic Session Expiry: Stale live sessions exceeding duration + 30m are automatically marked completed in the database.
- Pure WebRTC Legacy Cleanup: Purged obsolete Jitsi references and dead launch code across teacher and admin services.
